description: A finite indexed family of finite sets has a system of distinct representatives if and only if the union at every subset of the index set has at least as many elements as indices.
signature:
Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_existsInjective'.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Finite ι] [DecidableEq α]
  (t : ι → Finset α) :
  (∀ (s : Finset ι), s.card ≤ (s.biUnion t).card) ↔ ∃ f, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (x : ι), f x ∈ t x
